name: Summer at JWU – Summer Cooking Camps for Kids and Teens (Providence)
operator_name: Johnson & Wales University – College of Food Innovation & Technology (CFIT)
description_short: Five-day cooking day camps (8:30am-4pm) at Johnson & Wales University's Providence Kitchen Academy, taught by College of Food Innovation & Technology instructors. Kids camp (ages 8-12, $600) works in groups on culinary and pastry activities; teens camp (ages 13-17, $700) covers regional and global dishes and baking & pastry.
refund_policy_summary: Camp payments are nonrefundable within 30 days of the first camp day; cancellation notice must be in writing. If JWU cancels a camp, it refunds the cancelled portion to the original form of payment.

source.title: Summer at JWU | Providence | Johnson & Wales University
